definitions.explanation: Soft, delicate snow that melts quickly upon landing. Often used poetically to evoke a sense of transience and beauty.

examples.japanese: {淡雪|あわゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ちらちら→ちらちら：07407_chirachira⟧⟦{舞|ま}っている→舞う：04573_mau⟧。

examples.english: The light morning snow had disappeared by noon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{積|つ}もった→積もる：01964_tsumoru⟧{淡雪|あわゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦きらきら→きらきら：05159_kirakira⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The light snow that had accumulated in the garden was sparkling in the sunlight.

notes:
USAGE:
{淡雪|あわゆき} refers to light, delicate snow that melts easily. It carries a poetic, literary nuance and is frequently used in haiku and classical literature to symbolize transience.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {淡雪|あわゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧ (light snow falls)
- {淡雪|あわゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧ (light snow flutters)
- {淡雪|あわゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧ (light snow melts away)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {淡雪|あわゆき}: light, delicate snow that melts quickly (poetic)
- ⟦{粉雪|こなゆき}→粉雪：13858_konayuki⟧: powdery snow, fine dry snow
- ⟦{初雪|はつゆき}→初雪：11784_hatsuyuki⟧: first snow of the season
